How did an investment of ₹48 crore in Jio Platforms potentially turn into a stake valued at around ₹5,800 crore? Meet Mahendra Nahata, the telecom entrepreneur whose connection with Jio dates back to 2010.
Mahendra Nahata is the founder and Managing Director of HFCL (Himachal Futuristic Communications Limited). His business journey took a major turn when Infotel Broadband, the company that secured pan-India broadband wireless spectrum in 2010, was acquired by Reliance Industries.
